summary: @ornikar/jest-config preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: The package declares `scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`, which on `npm install` downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (selecting the archive by detecting the installer's architecture and probing `ldd --version` / `/etc/os-release` for Alpine/musl), unpacks the Bun binary locally, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) whose contents are opaque to Node-based static review. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, string-array indirection through `_0x19328d`; the Bun bundle uses a rotated numeric/string array and mangled identifiers). A Jest configuration preset has no functional need for an alternate language runtime or an install-time compiled payload; the runtime fetch exists specifically to execute the sibling bundle under an interpreter Node-based scanners cannot inspect. The Bun-host URL (github.com/oven-sh) is legitimate, but the executed content is the package's own opaque, obfuscated bundle, not a Bun-published artifact.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
